reviews.conclusion: Three visible pause/settings visits span combined proxy transition bounds 6.0-7.5 s. This alone does not close the 7.617 s deficit. A loading-terrain screen and roughly 2.25-2.75 s of severe game-window resizing also occur. These provide ordinary context with uncertain pause state; do not interpret the small timing difference as a residual anomaly or claim exact tick closure.

Three visible pause/settings visits span combined proxy transition bounds 4.25-5.75 s, compatible with 4.983 s deficit. Dimension transitions are visible as well. Exact native-frame attribution was not checked.
One visible options/video-settings visit spans proxy transition bounds 2.0-2.5 s, compatible with 2.367 s deficit. Inventory screens elsewhere are not counted as pauses.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
